articles.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2)
articles.executive_summary: Two unpatched critical PHP RCE flaws (CVSS 9.2) have been discovered, triggering an emergency security alert. PHP is releasing an out-of-cycle security update to address these vulnerabilities.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerabilities allow remote code execution (RCE) and have been rated 9.2 on the CVSS v4.0 scale. The exact details of the flaws have not been disclosed by PHP's security team.
actionable_mitigations: Wait for the official PHP security advisory and patch release at 14:00 UTC on October 21.
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block access to vulnerable PHP versions.
Monitor for detection and log indicators related to the vulnerabilities.
articles.telegram_snippet: PHP issues emergency security alert for two critical RCE flaws (CVSS 9.2). Out-of-cycle security update to be released at 14:00 UTC on October 21.
